title: Proper integral constructible heart upper bound
statement: For the integral coefficients and standing finite-type setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] [sk-def-sfb-constructible], let p:X→Y be proper with geometric fibres of dimension at most d≥0. For every finite constant-model constructible integral module N, ordinary Rp_*(N[0]) [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] lies in D^{≤2d+1}. The ambient category and finite reductions are those of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]; no rational coefficients are substituted.

source.place: Proof (1), completion of the constructible heart estimate

proof.text: Transport the continuous integer coefficients along the canonical ring isomorphism to the finite-extension convention of derived completion. The transport is exact and preserves finite constant models. Proper integral preservation makes the image derived complete.
Apply the positive reduction estimate with b=0 to the transported N[0]; every image reduction is bounded above by 2d.

The specified completion map is invertible and its augmented Roos triangle has the two products of the integral levels. Exact countable products and cohomology compatibility bound both products above by 2d. Inverse rotation of the triangle bounds the completed object above by 2d+1. Transport this bound back along the coefficient equivalence.

theorem integralProperConstructibleHeartBound
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p₀ : ℕ) [CharP k p₀] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hpℓ : p₀ ≠ ℓ)
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim
      (pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) (AlgebraicClosure (Y.residueField y)))) ≫
          Y.fromSpecResidueField y) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)),
      IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X N →
      ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N)).IsLE (2 * (d : ℤ) + 1)
